# Shuffle the Array

## Solution

```java
class Solution {
    public int[] shuffle(int[] nums, int n) {
        int[] ans = new int[2 * n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){
            ans[2 * i] = nums[i];
            ans[2 * i + 1] = nums[i + n];
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
```
